operations.ambiguous_window: request accepted before response or process exit before caller ACK
operations.audit_surface: body-free bridge diagnostics and Telegram receipt when returned

operations.idempotency_key: old and new commit SHA plus installer generation stamps
operations.ambiguous_window: repository or installed artifacts changed before terminal audit
operations.audit_surface: body-free self-update audit record and notification result
operations.approval_boundary: reviewed procedure plus operator-owned service allowlist

operations.ambiguous_window: spool file created before lastRunAt/runHistory ACK
operations.audit_surface: body-free spool path and redacted owner text envelope

operations.idempotency_key: registry pending-wake journal keyed by wait_id; terminal finish is journaled before any delivery
operations.ambiguous_window: owner notice accepted by the push spool or continuation admitted before mark_wake persists, so a later drain may repeat it
operations.audit_surface: external-wait registry wake record (delivered/resumed/skip_reason) plus body-free bridge diagnostics
operations.approval_boundary: auto-resume gate: resume_enabled flag, daily cap, and exact-head terminal pinning; gh transport stays read-only

operations.idempotency_key: skill-autosave.seen and .notified ledgers keyed by transcript identity and growth snapshot
operations.ambiguous_window: auto-mode installer moved a passing draft before its post-hoc notice was queued or logged, leaving install state verifiable only via the installed-by ledger
operations.audit_surface: pending-skills queue, installed-by=autosave ownership ledger, rollback archive, and skill-autosave.log
operations.approval_boundary: approve mode by default installs nothing; auto install requires explicit mode opt-in plus the machine gate and daily cap in autoinstall.sh

operations.ambiguous_window: systemctl accepted the restart before the unit reached its target state or the wrapper exited while the stop/start cycle was still in flight
operations.audit_surface: wrapper stderr naming only the unit plus systemd journal records for the restarted unit
operations.approval_boundary: root-owned regular wrapper plus exact-unit allowlist /etc/ccc-node/service-control.allow with no group/world writable paths

operations.idempotency_key: task ledger terminal_op records keyed by task_id and journaled before the first Telegram call, with an attempts cap of 20
operations.ambiguous_window: Telegram accepted the edit or delete before resolve_terminal_op could purge the outbox entry, so a later drain repeats it until BadRequest confirms an already-gone or unmodified state
operations.audit_surface: body-free task ledger terminal_op attempts counter plus bridge debug diagnostics naming task ids only
operations.approval_boundary: automatic housekeeping limited to bot-authored status messages recorded in the task ledger; user content is never deleted
